title: An agent may add and link image attachments to an essay, but never place them in it

sections.name: words
sections.label: Owner, 2026-11-24
sections.content: An agent should be able to add image attachments and link them to an essay, but it can't place them in the essay itself.

sections.name: context
sections.content: Said after learning that the essay write guard (srs-web essay-document.ts essayWriteGuard) keeps agents out of the essay body, and that an agent has no path to put an image near an essay at all. Bears on decision 82fbca88 / muDemocracy.org#226 (agents never write essay text) and D5 72bcd83e (alt text is the writer's).
